body: The desk published no verified stories today, so this edition draws entirely on the desk's own market boards. Those boards show a market that firmed modestly on the day while remaining lower over the past week, a pattern consistent across nearly every asset the desk tracks.

Bitcoin traded at $83,199 on the desk's board, up 1.6% on the day but down 4.6% over the past week and up 5.9% over the past month. Ethereum, Solana, XRP, BNB, Dogecoin, and Cardano all show the same shape: a positive day against a negative week, with Cardano the exception on the monthly window at up 12.3%. The desk's Fear & Greed reading sits at 57, labeled Greed, within its 30-day range of 50 to 78.

With no desk stories today, the drivers behind the day's modest bounce are not addressed in the desk's own reporting. The regulatory watch list carries several live storylines the desk has covered in prior editions, including matters in the European Union, Japan, the United States, and Russia, but none of the stated dates attached to those storylines fall on or near today, so no fresh checkpoint applies this evening.

The desk's Whale Watch board shows $76,108,744 in ether moving off exchanges over the trailing 24 hours, with the board's biggest single moves being ether withdrawals of $75,575,184 and $56,639,421 from Coinbase Institutional. Over a longer window, the board's weekly figures show the week ending Oct 13 saw $1,557 million move onto exchanges, the largest weekly onto-exchange figure in the board's four most recent weekly readings, following a week ending Oct 06 in which $255 million moved off exchanges. The desk's leverage board shows calm funding across major assets, with bitcoin funding on OKX at -0.0041% over 8 hours (-4.5% annualized) and open interest of $2,433,776,646, alongside a bitcoin long/short ratio of 1.3.
The desk's own boards do not resolve which of those two signals, the day's bounce or the week's drawdown, will dominate going forward; that is a question the coming days' data will need to answer.
